content: Lenacapavir, a moderate inhibitor of the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, can increase the levels or effects of medications metabolized by this enzyme. This interaction may elevate the risk of adverse reactions associated with these drugs. The effect of lenacapavir on CYP3A4 substrates can persist for up to nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. Therefore, caution and close monitoring are recommended when co-administering lenacapavir with CYP3A4 substrates. For specific drugs, the following considerations apply: 1. Entrectinib: Lenacapavir may increase the levels or effects of entrectinib. Monitor for potential adverse reactions. 2. Enzalutamide: Lenacapavir may elevate enzalutamide levels, necessitating caution and monitoring. 3. Eplerenone: Lenacapavir may increase eplerenone levels, requiring careful observation for adverse effects. 4. Ergoloid Mesylates: Lenacapavir may enhance the effects of ergoloid mesylates. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Ergonovine: Lenacapavir may increase ergonovine levels, necessitating monitoring for adverse reactions. 6. Erlotinib: Lenacapavir may elevate erlotinib levels. Monitor for potential toxicity. 7. Erythromycin (Base, Ethylsuccinate, Lactobionate, Stearate): Lenacapavir may increase erythromycin levels, requiring close monitoring. 8. Escitalopram: Lenacapavir may enhance escitalopram levels. Use caution and monitor for adverse effects. 9. Esomeprazole: Lenacapavir may increase esomeprazole levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 10. Estradiol, Conjugated Estrogens, Esterified Estrogens, Estropipate: Lenacapavir may elevate estrogen levels, necessitating monitoring for adverse effects. 11. Eszopiclone: Lenacapavir may increase eszopiclone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Ethinyl Estradiol: Lenacapavir may enhance ethinyl estradiol levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 13. Ethosuximide: Lenacapavir may increase ethosuximide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Etoposide: Lenacapavir may elevate etoposide levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 15. Etravirine: Lenacapavir may increase etravirine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Everolimus: Lenacapavir may enhance everolimus levels. Monitor for potential toxicity. 17. Exemestane: Lenacapavir may increase exemestane levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Fedratinib: Lenacapavir may elevate fedratinib levels. Monitor for adverse effects. 19. Felbamate: Lenacapavir may increase felbamate levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Felodipine: Lenacapavir may enhance felodipine levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 21. Fenofibrate (including Micronized and Fenofibric Acid): Lenacapavir may increase fenofibrate levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 22. Fentanyl (including Intranasal, Iontophoretic Transdermal, and Transdermal): Lenacapavir may elevate fentanyl levels, increasing the risk of potentially fatal respiratory depression. Monitor therapeutic effects and adverse reactions closely. 23. Flunisolide (Inhaled): Lenacapavir may increase flunisolide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Flurazepam: Lenacapavir may enhance flurazepam levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 25. Flutamide: Lenacapavir may increase flutamide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Fluticasone Furoate: Lenacapavir may elevate fluticasone levels. Monitor for adverse effects. 27. Fosamprenavir: Lenacapavir may increase fosamprenavir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Fosaprepitant: Lenacapavir may enhance fosaprepitant levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 29. Fostamatinib: Lenacapavir may increase fostamatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Fostemsavir: Lenacapavir may elevate fostemsavir levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 31. Futibatinib: Lenacapavir may increase futibatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Ganaxolone: Lenacapavir may enhance ganaxolone levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 33. Gefitinib: Lenacapavir may increase gefitinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Gepirone: Lenacapavir may elevate gepirone levels. Reduce the gepirone dose by 50% when co-administered with lenacapavir. 35. Glasdegib: Lenacapavir may increase glasdegib levels. Monitor for adverse effects. 36. Glecaprevir/Pibrentasvir: Lenacapavir may enhance glecaprevir/pibrentasvir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 37. Guanfacine: Lenacapavir may increase guanfacine levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 38. Haloperidol: Lenacapavir may elevate haloperidol levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Hydrocodone: Lenacapavir may increase hydrocodone levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 40. Hydrocortisone: Lenacapavir may significantly increase hydrocortisone levels, potentially leading to toxicities such as Cushing syndrome or adrenal suppression. Initiate dexamethasone at the lowest dose, monitor, and titrate accordingly. 41. Hydroxyprogesterone Caproate: Lenacapavir may enhance hydroxyprogesterone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Ibrutinib: Lenacapavir may increase ibrutinib levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 43. Idelalisib: Lenacapavir may elevate idelalisib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Ifosfamide: Lenacapavir may increase ifosfamide levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 45. Imatinib: Lenacapavir may enhance imatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Indinavir: Lenacapavir may increase indinavir levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 47. Irinotecan (including Liposomal): Lenacapavir may elevate irinotecan levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Isavuconazonium Sulfate: Lenacapavir may increase isavuconazonium levels. Monitor for adverse effects. 49. Isosorbide Dinitrate and Mononitrate: Lenacapavir may enhance isosorbide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 50. Istradefylline: Lenacapavir may increase istradefylline levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 51. Itraconazole: Lenacapavir may elevate itraconazole levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 52. Ivabradine: Lenacapavir may increase ivabradine levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 53. Ivacaftor: Lenacapavir may enhance ivacaftor levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 54. Ivosidenib: Lenacapavir may increase ivosidenib levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 55. Ixabepilone: Lenacapavir may elevate ixabepilone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 56. Ixazomib: Lenacapavir may increase ixazomib levels. Monitor for adverse reactions. 57. Ketamine: Lenacapavir may enhance ketamine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 58. Lacosamide: Lenacapavir may increase lacosamide levels. Monitor for potential side effects. 59. Lansoprazole: Lenacapavir may elevate lansoprazole levels. Use caution and monitor closely. In all cases, healthcare providers should carefully monitor therapeutic effects and adverse reactions, adjusting therapy as needed to minimize risks.
